versions.changelog:
- Initial release of estimation-patterns meta-skill, providing practical techniques for software estimation.
- Includes method comparisons (T-shirt sizing, story points, time-based, three-point, reference comparison) with pros/cons.
- Covers systematic task decomposition, complexity multipliers, buffer calculation, and focus ratio guidelines.
- Offers historical calibration techniques and tables for tracking estimate accuracy.
- Lists common estimation biases with mitigation strategies.
- Recommends estimation heuristics by task type for fast baseline estimates.
